authority: apostila-cga-2026; adversarial review of the automatic_surfaces ordering fix
method: every occurrence of each moved form read; the receiving concepts confirmed to exist and to be correctly scoped
reason: A concept may gather many spellings of one sense; it may not gather two senses that are opposites, because the canonical rewrite substitutes any of its forms for the preferred one. `technical.option` held `opção de venda` (put) AND `opção de compra` (call) with the call preferred, so every put in the corpus was rewritten into a call — the financial instrument inverted. `technical.put_option` and `technical.call_option` already existed, correctly scoped; the specific forms belong to them and the generic `opção` stays with the general concept. A rewrite-safety guard now refuses this class of substitution outright, but a guard that catches a modelling error is not a reason to keep it.

operations.why: The general concept's preferred label was `opção de compra`, which is a CALL — the specific instrument standing as the label of the family that contains its opposite. `opção` is what the corpus writes for the general instrument and what the family is.
A put, not the general option. `technical.put_option` owns it.
13 occurrences of the put, moved to the concept that is the put.
The call, moved to the concept that is the call.
`expressamente previsto` is a manner adverb about how a provision is written, not a polarity marker. Batch 33 registers it as modality.explicitly.
